annotations.title: Why a Microsoft ad or keyword was disapproved

description: WHY a Microsoft Advertising ad or keyword was DISAPPROVED: Microsoft's editorial reason codes, the word or phrase it objected to (term), where it appeared (location), the countries it applies to, and any appeal status, read live from Microsoft. Use it whenever a read-back shows editorialStatus Disapproved, or the user asks why a Bing ad is not running. Pass adGroupId plus adIds OR keywordIds (Microsoft will not mix ads and keywords in one request). The reply links Microsoft's table of what each code means. Free.

adAccountId.description: Microsoft ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

adGroupId.description: the ad group the ads or keywords sit in

keywordIds.description: or the keywords to explain (not both)

name: microsoft_ads_editorial_reasons
